page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs, operating with 1.0 thread per core under KVM virtualization. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal a distinct contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is weak, as demonstrated by stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, alongside poor single-threaded gzip compression. However, the instance leverages its 32 dedicated cores to achieve average multi-core performance in stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression. Memory bandwidth remains average for both small and large block read/write operations, though the overall Passmark memory score registers as weak.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn1ne.8xlarge offers a high-density CPU profile with a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, making it a viable option for parallelizable workloads that do not require high single-thread performance or local storage. It is suited for multi-threaded applications such as static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and moderate multi-threaded text or image processing. It can also handle basic medium-sized LLM inference tasks, though text generation speeds remain modest.
